evaluation.summary: 本轮业务（联系人/地址簿）在冻结框架上通过 Agent 搭建并全量浏览器验收（B01–B04 全过），主要框架问题有两个：app-server 的 SPA catch-all 会把未匹配的 /api/* GET 回落成 200 HTML，掩盖 API 404；认证相关的路由/测试指引未在写请求示例处提示 cookie 写请求的 Origin/CSRF 前提，Agent 需读 dist 源码才定位到 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN。可用能力突出：@nocobase/db 的迁移/seed/Repository、@nocobase/app-server 的 scope 化路由与服务令牌、@nocobase/app-client + @nocobase/i18n 的路由/API/i18n 入口，以及主动记录模板 DataTable 缺口的 table.md。覆盖限制：快照未包含被 app-client 再导出的 @nocobase/api-client、@nocobase/realtime 运行时包，且模型不支持图像，未做跨页面视觉评审。

modules.name: 数据访问与迁移/种子（@nocobase/db）
modules.scope: 联系人集合的建表迁移、初始化种子，以及运行时的 Repository CRUD 与错误路径。
modules.limitations: 仅阅读了 dist 公开实现与 Skill；未执行数据库，可靠性结论基于实现与 QA 行为。

requirements.need: 联系人记录的新增、查询、修改、删除。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 Collection/Repository 的读写与过滤器语义。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 解析 databaseManagerToken 一次，用 db.repository('contacts') 的 createOne/findOne/updateOne/deleteOne，findOne 需 filter 或非空 sort。
requirements.actualUsage: ContactsService 解析 databaseManagerToken 后用 Repository CRUD，并把 RepositoryError 映射为业务错误码。

requirements.need: 为 contacts 建立结构与索引。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 defineMigration + Collection Builder。
requirements.recommendedUsage: defineMigration({up({builder})}) 中 builder.createCollection 声明字段与索引。
requirements.actualUsage: 迁移用 defineMigration 与 builder.createCollection 建立 contacts 并加 name/department 索引。

requirements.need: 初始化 5 条示例联系人。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 seed 原语与幂等约定；是否需要示例数据由业务决定。
requirements.recommendedUsage: defineSeed + context.repository(name).upsertOne 以唯一业务键保证重复运行为 no-op。
requirements.actualUsage: 表无唯一列，Agent 用 count()>0 守卫 + createOne 循环，并把示例数据放进 seed。

requirementFit.reason: 迁移、seed、Repository CRUD 都是框架直接能力，覆盖了联系人持久化的全部职责；示例数据的落点只影响约定而非能力。

usability.reason: databaseManagerToken + db.repository() 入口单一，findOne 的 INVALID_FILTER 等前置约束在类型与错误码中可读，接入步骤短。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 对迁移/seed/Repository 讲得很细；但“seed 不是示例内容”与本任务“seed 5 条示例”正面冲突，Agent 只能自行取舍。

design.reason: Manager/Connection/Repository/Query/Builder 分层清晰，defineMigration/defineSeed 用标记函数降低接入面。

reliability.reason: updateOne 的 writePolicy、findOne 的 INVALID_FILTER、deleteOne/updateOne 的 RECORD_NOT_FOUND 映射均在实现中兑现，写路径不会静默吞错。

modules.name: 服务装配与 HTTP 路由（@nocobase/app-server + @nocobase/service-provider）
modules.scope: 业务 REST 路由的注册与 /api 挂载、服务令牌与 Provider 生命周期，以及未匹配 API 请求的回落行为。
modules.limitations: 未启动应用；路由挂载顺序与 SPA 回落结论来自 dist 实现与 Agent 日志。

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/server-routes.md
entrypoints: Every route owns its own security

requirements.need: 在 /api 下暴露联系人 CRUD。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 defineApiRoutes 与 scope 挂载。
requirements.recommendedUsage: defineApiRoutes((app)=>{ ... include auth.required() in the factory ... })，框架把 scope=api 挂到 /api。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 用 defineApiRoutes + 独立 Hono 子路由，contactsRouter.use('*', auth.required())。

requirements.need: 把认证/业务服务注入路由而不重复解析。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 token 化容器与 Provider 生命周期。
requirements.actualUsage: ContactsProvider 用 createServiceToken 注册，路由在工厂内一次性 resolve authenticationToken 与 contactServiceToken。

requirements.need: 未匹配的 /api/* GET 应得到可识别的 JSON 404。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责把 SPA fallback 与 API 命名空间分开。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 未在指引中说明；server-routes.md 只讲 route 自身的鉴权与响应。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 遇到 GET /api/contacts/1 返回 index.html，随后显式补 GET /:contactId 才拿到 CONTACT_NOT_FOUND。

requirementFit.reason: REST 路由、/api 挂载与认证组合都可用；但未匹配 API 请求会被 SPA 兜底掩盖，路由契约不完整。

usability.reason: defineApiRoutes + Hono 子路由的组合简单，routerToken 把路由当服务暴露；缺失的是 API 404 的可预期性。

agentFriendliness.reason: 指引把路由安全讲清楚了，却未提示未匹配 /api/* 会回落 HTML，Agent 只能靠观察发现并自行补路由。

design.reason: scope 化路由贡献 + frozen 描述符 + 服务令牌，边界清楚、可组合。

reliability.reason: 实现按 scope 挂载正确，但 SPA catch-all 让缺失 API 路由以 200 text/html 静默成功，违背 REST 错误路径的可预期性。

modules.name: 认证与写请求 CSRF（@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication）
modules.scope: 业务路由的会话保护、cookie 写请求的 Origin/CSRF 校验及其指引。
modules.limitations: 未单独构造 CSRF 复现；结论来自 dist 实现、Skill 文本与 Agent 调试日志。

requirements.need: 保护联系人写接口，未登录拒绝。
requirements.responsibility: 框架插件提供 required() 中间件。
requirements.recommendedUsage: container.resolve(authenticationToken) 后在子路由 use('*', auth.required())。
requirements.actualUsage: contactsRouter.use('*', auth.required())，并在应用配置中设置 publicOrigin。

requirements.need: 浏览器 cookie 写请求的 CSRF 防护。
requirements.responsibility: 框架插件默认 fail-closed 校验 Origin/Referer。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 配置 app.publicOrigin；跨源前端加入 auth.trustedOrigins；写请求带匹配 Origin。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 起初只带 set-cookie 调用 POST 得 403，读 dist 后定位 checkCookieWriteOrigin，补 Origin/APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN 才通过。

requirements.need: 集成测试用真实插件登录后再调受保护接口。
requirements.responsibility: 指引给出可运行的测试配方。
requirements.recommendedUsage: createAuthentication 后 sign up，复用 set-cookie，并为写请求补 Origin/trusted origin。
requirements.actualUsage: 指引示例只演示 GET，Agent 需自行补 Origin 才能完成写请求测试。

requirementFit.reason: 会话保护与 cookie 写 CSRF 都是插件默认能力，直接覆盖业务接口的认证与 CSRF 职责。

usability.reason: fail-closed 正确，但缺少 Origin 时统一 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN，且要求分散在部署 reference，首次接入需要反查实现。

agentFriendliness.reason: 认证 Skill 与 server-routes.md 都未在写请求示例处提示 CSRF 前提；Agent 通过读 auth.js 才恢复，属可改进的发现链。

design.reason: checkCookieWriteOrigin 独立于会话读取，required/optional 都先执行，含 skip 路由；forConnection 支持事务绑定。

reliability.reason: 实现对 GET/HEAD/OPTIONS、无 cookie 的 API key、同源 sec-fetch-site 与 trusted origins 都有明确分支，错误码稳定。

evidence.excerpt:
# Database and data access

This page is how an application reaches the database and where that code belongs. The API itself — Repository, QueryAdapter, transactions, naming, and the criterion for choosing between the two layers — belongs to the package that owns it: read `.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md` sections 4 and 5, and run `pnpm nocobase skills sync` if that file is missing. Schema changes are migrations; see [migrations and seeds](migrations.md).

## Resolving the database

Resolve `databaseManagerToken` from the container:

```ts
import { databaseManagerToken } from '@nocobase/db';

const database = app.container.resolve(databaseManagerToken);
```

In a route factory, resolve it once in the factory rather than inside each handler. In a service, take it as a constructor dependency — see [services and jobs](services-and-jobs.md).

From there, `database.repository(collection)` is the default for a collection's records and their relations, `database.query()` is for a result set that is not any collection's records, and `database.transaction(fn)` groups writes that must succeed or fail together. Each takes an optional connection name and uses the default connection when omitted.

Keep `@nocobase/db` in `dependencies`, not `devDependencies`. The deployed server resolves it at runtime, and TypeScript also reads that declaration to infer the database configuration through the public package name; declaring it only as a development dependency can cause TS2883 in an installed application even while a source workspace builds successfully.

evidence.excerpt:
**Public origin.** Set `app.publicOrigin` to the HTTPS address the browser
sees. Better Auth derives its base URL and callback URLs from it and from the
application's public base path; a container-internal address breaks OAuth
callbacks and cookie attributes. The reverse proxy must forward host,
protocol, and cookies.

**Business request CSRF.** `Auth.required()` and `Auth.optional()` reject cookie-bearing writes unless `Origin` (or, when absent, `Referer`) matches Better Auth's configured base origin or a trusted origin. Configure `app.publicOrigin` for deployed applications and add separate frontend origins through `auth.trustedOrigins`; without a trusted origin, browser writes fail closed with `INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN`. Cookie-free API key requests can proceed after authentication. A credential header does not exempt a request carrying cookies, including routes that skip session lookup.

## Testing a protected route

Route tests should not sign in through Better Auth. Register a stub under
`authenticationToken` whose `required()` and `optional()` set the session you
want, then assert both the anonymous and the authenticated response:

```ts
const container = new ServiceContainer();
container.instance(authenticationToken, testAuth);

const router = await apiRoutes.createRouter({ /* ... */ container });

expect((await router.request('/orders')).status).toBe(401);
```

The application Skill's testing reference shows the full `createRouter` call
and a `testAuth` shape. For an integration test that exercises the real
plugin, build an `Auth` with `createAuthentication({ connection, secret })`
against a test database, sign up through `auth.handler()` with a
`POST /api/auth/sign-up/email` request, and reuse the returned `set-cookie`
header on later requests. The plugin's own integration tests do exactly this.

## Developing against another backend

Do not hard-code `/main` from the examples below. It is only the fallback for an unset `APP_BASE_PATH`. Local development resolves that variable from the command-line environment, then `.env.local`, then `.env`. The remote mount path is independently supplied in `PROXY_TARGET_URL`: inspect the target application's actual public URL instead of assuming it matches the local path. For example, `APP_BASE_PATH=/local PROXY_TARGET_URL=http://127.0.0.1:13000/crm pnpm dev` forwards local `/local/api` and `/local/ws` to remote `/crm/api` and `/crm/ws`.

Use `PROXY_TARGET_URL=https://backend.example.com/main pnpm dev` to run only the local Vite client against another application's API and WebSocket service. The URL is the remote application base, including its mount path, without `/api`. Open the printed Local URL. The local server and server watchers are skipped; `beforeDev` hooks still run. Requests, including writes, affect the target backend. See README.MD for path mapping and authentication requirements. Leave the variable unset for normal full-stack development.

The development proxy adapts same-origin HTTP and WebSocket Origin headers to the target origin, and maps same-origin Referer paths to the target app base. Other origins remain unchanged and missing Origin headers are not added. Keep backend origin checks enabled; this adaptation belongs only to Vite development, not production deployment. Production uses `APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN` and a reverse proxy that preserves the public Host and protocol.

NocoBase packages may publish Skills under `.agents/skills/`. Current application templates run `pnpm nocobase skills sync` automatically through `postinstall`; run it manually if install scripts were disabled or that directory is missing or stale. Confirm that the package is a direct `@nocobase/*` dependency or a registered plugin before relying on its Skill. The common capability mappings are:

| The requirement sounds like                                                                   | Read the Skill for                    |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| Approvals, multi-step processes, "when X happens then Y"                                      | `@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow`       |
| An assistant in the app: chat, reading files dropped into it, acting through tools you define | `@nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee`    |
| Email, IM, or in-app messages                                                                 | `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification`   |
| Roles, permissions, per-user or per-record access                                             | `@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization`  |
| Sign-in, registration, sessions                                                               | `@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication` |
| File upload and metadata through Repository                                                   | `@nocobase/app-plugin-file`           |
| Translated text and language switching                                                        | `@nocobase/app-plugin-i18n`           |
| User administration and application-owned role assignment                                     | `@nocobase/app-plugin-users`          |
| Reading or writing data, schema changes, migrations                                           | `@nocobase/db`                        |

Read the relevant Skill before writing the feature, but treat this table as a map rather than an installed-package list. Implementing a permission system, a notification sender, or a scheduler by hand when a registered plugin provides one is the most expensive mistake available here.

## Public surfaces

Server, from `@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication` (the root entry is the
server entry) or `@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication/server`:

- `authenticationToken` resolves the `Auth` instance: `required()`,
  `optional()`, `getSession(headers)`, `handler(request)`.
- `AuthEnv` types a Hono router whose routes read `context.get('auth')`.
- `userAdministrationServiceToken` resolves `UserAdministrationService`:
  `list`, `get`, `create`, `update`, `disable`, `enable`, `resetPassword`,
  `revokeSessions`, `withConnection`; errors are `UserAdministrationError`.
- `AuthConfig` is Better Auth's `BetterAuthOptions`, the type of the application's `server/config/auth.ts`. User initialization configuration lives separately under `users.initialAdmin`.
- `createAuthentication`, `databaseAdapter`, `createAuthStorage` build an
  instance outside the application runtime, mainly in tests.
